script.voiceoverScript: These five mistakes can ruin your next holiday. Plan your route before leaving the hotel. Avoid restaurants beside major landmarks. Keep your valuables secure in busy areas. Do not attempt every attraction in one day. Follow for more practical travel advice.

scenes.narration: These five mistakes can ruin your holiday.
scenes.visualDirection: Fast montage of a busy holiday destination.

scenes.narration: Plan carefully and avoid obvious tourist traps.
scenes.visualDirection: Map planning followed by a restaurant menu.

scenes.narration: Protect your valuables and leave time to enjoy the trip.
scenes.visualDirection: Crowded street followed by a relaxed café.

script.callToAction: Follow for more practical travel advice.
